brief: Fully prepared meals that go from fridge to plate in 2 minutes. $11-14 per meal, weekly subscription. Targeting busy professionals and fitness folks.

profile.business_summary: Fully prepared meals delivered via a weekly subscription, priced at $11-14 per meal, designed to go from fridge to plate in 2 minutes. The brand targets busy professionals and fitness enthusiasts.
stated_claims: Fully prepared meals that go from fridge to plate in 2 minutes

relevant_tags.why: The core product is fully prepared meals, which directly falls under the meal kits and prepared food delivery category.
The business model is strictly a weekly subscription.
Meals that heat in 2 minutes strongly appeal to convenience-seeking consumers.
Prepared meals serve as a replacement or supplement for traditional grocery shopping.
Prepared meals targeting fitness folks align well with health and wellness DTC brands.

note_signals.why: High-frequency convenience and grocery shoppers are highly likely to adopt quick prepared meals.
Fitness-engaged shoppers strongly align with the advertiser's target audience of 'fitness folks'.
Studiogrid's users are actively spending on self-care and fitness, matching the target demographic.
Direct competitor selling meal kits and subscription groceries on their checkout page.
Cloudfoot's urban professional audience perfectly matches the 'busy professionals' target.

profile.gate_reason: The product, pricing model, and target audience are clearly defined, allowing for immediate planning.

pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.76-$1.04 per click (median $0.89), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.

allocations.rationale: market price $0.52-$0.67 (median $0.59); bidding $0.35 wins ~0% of page views, paying ~$0.35 per click (second price)
